name: pcb
description: Sourced PCB design knowledge, JLCEDA Pro working-copy editing and native autorouting, with local Windows-MCP control.

interface.shortDescription: Research and edit PCB copies with JLCEDA Pro routing
interface.longDescription: Research PCB constraints, inspect native netlists and physical pad connectivity, use JLCEDA Pro to make finite working-copy edits and run the native autorouter, and control the desktop through an allowlisted local Windows-MCP server. Router jobs require explicit net/layer selection and report terminal/ratline state. DRC, manufacturing and functional evidence remain separate checks.
defaultPrompt: Use PCB to inspect this schematic-to-board design and list sourced constraints and checks still needed.
Search the PCB knowledge base for four-layer MCU layout guidance.
Inspect the structure of the local JLCEDA Pro project read-only.
